sources.snippet: Kapitsa is an inference engine for Apple silicon that runs Qwen, Nemotron and Recursive's Flint models locally, built for coding agents. It starts opencode, Claude Code, Codex or pi on a local model, and serves OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. Kapitsa has the fastest decode in 33 of the 38 model and Mac ...
